the conductivity of thin ionic films is not simply proportional to their thickness, and the proportionality coefficient, the effective conductivity, depends on the film thickness, and that the thickness dependence of the effective conductivity is governed by the Debye length and the electric surface potential.

the defect chemistry of thin ionic films is determined by the finite sample thickness, and that conductivity experiments on thin films provide important information about the defect chemistry.
